groups.name: Chat
groups.about: Language models for chat and the agent, as GGUF (4-bit).

groups.name: Images
groups.about: Pictures from a description, and edits.

groups.name: Video
groups.about: Short clips from a description or a picture.

groups.name: Speech
groups.about: Speech in voices you describe or save.

groups.name: Music
groups.about: Songs with vocals from lyrics and a description.

groups.name: Sound effects
groups.about: Ambience, creatures, machines and actions from a description.

groups.name: 3D models
groups.about: Textured 3D models (GLB) from a picture of an object.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.about: A strong all-round chat model: reasoning, coding and tool use. The best first choice for a 12 GB GPU or larger.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.about: The small Qwen3.5: reasoning and tool use, for a GPU with 6 GB or less, or the CPU.

models.name: Qwen3.5 27B
models.about: The large Qwen3.5: stronger reasoning, coding and tool use, for a GPU with 24 GB or more (on a smaller one it runs split with the CPU, slower).

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.about: Qwen3.8 at 27B, 4-bit (Q4_K_M): strong reasoning, coding and tool use, for a GPU with 24 GB or more.

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B (8-bit, near full quality)
models.about: Qwen3.8 27B at 8 bits (Q8_0), all but indistinguishable from the original weights: for a GPU with 32 GB or more, or split with the CPU.

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B (3-bit)
models.about: Qwen3.8 27B at 3 bits (Q3_K_M), for a GPU with 16 GB. (The 3.21-bit OrcaSAQ build below is closer to the original.)

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B (3.21-bit OrcaSAQ)
models.about: OrcaRouter's 3.21-bit Qwen3.8 27B (EXL3): closer to the original than a 3-bit GGUF, with tool use and reasoning. It runs on a 16 GB GPU of any kind, through WebGPU.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.about: Qwen's large mixture of experts (EXL3, 3.05 bits) with tool use and a long context: about 48 GB of weights, and a 32.6 GB n-gram table read from the disk as it is needed. It runs through WebGPU on GPUs of any kind: over two 32 GB GPUs, or on one with the experts that do not fit decoded on the CPU, far more slowly.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.about: Z.ai's large mixture of experts with tool use, as unsloth's 4-bit dynamic GGUF of the official weights: its experts stream from RAM and the disk as they are needed, so it wants a fast SSD and plenty of RAM. On any GPU through WebGPU about a token a second once warm, its dense layers in about 6 GB of VRAM.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.about: DeepSeek's 552B mixture of experts, read from its FP8 checkpoint, with tool use: its experts stream from RAM and the disk, so it needs a fast SSD and a lot of memory. It runs through WebGPU on one GPU of any kind (12 GB or more), its dense layers (up to 9.7 GB) there and its experts on the CPU: about a token a second, a long first prompt taking minutes, and no images yet.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.about: Qwen's own 8B chat model, with a thinking mode for harder questions.

models.name: Qwen3 4B
models.about: A small, quick chat model for GPUs with 6 GB or less, or for the CPU.

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.about: Google's compact Gemma 4, for chat; on a GPU it reads pictures too (its vision projector comes with it).

models.name: MiniCPM-V 4.7 1B
models.about: OpenBMB's small vision model: it reads a picture in detail (a large one in up to nine slices) and answers about it, quickly on any GPU. Its vision projector comes with it.

models.name: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B
models.about: OpenBMB's larger vision model, a mixture of experts (3B of its 35B weights a token): it reads pictures in detail and chats well. Needs a 24 GB GPU (an RTX 4090 runs it at some 120 tokens a second). Its vision projector comes with it.

models.name: LFM2.5 24B-A2B
models.about: Liquid AI's reasoning model for agents, a mixture of experts (2B of its 24B weights a token), so it is quick: some 220 tokens a second on an RTX 4090, 46 on an M5 Pro. It thinks before every answer and calls tools. Needs a 16 GB GPU.
models.license: LFM Open License 1.0 (commercial use only below US$10M annual revenue)

models.name: Gemma 3 4B
models.about: Google's Gemma 3 at 4B, for chat. (OAIY's engine does not read pictures with it yet.)

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B
models.about: Meta's small Llama: light and fast, for everyday chat on modest hardware.

models.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (4-bit)
models.about: Qwen's eight-step Turbo of Qwen Image 2.1, its transformer and text encoder as 4-bit GGUFs: pictures with legible text, and edits by instruction, on a GPU with 12 GB or more.

models.name: Qwen Image 2.1 (turbo)
models.about: High-quality pictures with legible text, and edits by instruction, in six steps with Viggle's turbo adapter. Streams its weights on GPUs under 24 GB.

models.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein
models.about: Black Forest Labs' 5.6B model: pictures with legible text, edits of up to ten reference pictures, and placement by boxes in the prompt, in 16 steps. Its weights are gated: accept its licence on huggingface.co and add a Hugging Face token first.
models.license: FLUX Kommunity License (non-commercial use; commercial outputs for qualifying users, see its terms)

models.name: MOSS-Image SFT
models.about: OpenMOSS's 5B model: pictures from a description, tags or a JSON layout of boxes, with legible lettering in English and Chinese, in 50 steps. Its text encoder is Qwen3.5-9B.

models.name: MOSS-Image SFT (4-bit)
models.about: MOSS-Image SFT with its transformer and its Qwen3.5-9B text encoder as 4-bit GGUFs: the same pictures, a little less exact, on a GPU with 8 GB or more.

models.name: Stable Diffusion XL 1.0
models.about: The classic SDXL base model: quick pictures on 8 GB GPUs, with negative prompts.

models.name: LTX 2.5
models.about: Lightricks' video model: clips with sound from a description or a start picture, and speech a clip can follow. Streams its weights on GPUs under 48 GB.

models.name: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B
models.about: Speech in any voice you describe in words, and voices you save to reuse, in ten languages.

models.name: Breeze TTS 2
models.about: An alternative voice model for described and saved voices.

models.name: MiniMax Music 3
models.about: Songs up to six minutes with vocals and instruments, from lyrics and a description, or instrumentals.

models.name: MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0
models.about: Up to 30 seconds of 48 kHz sound from a description: rain, footsteps, engines, creatures.

models.name: Pixal3D
models.about: A textured 3D model from one picture of an object, with DINOv3 and NAF to read the picture. Brings BiRefNet and Real-ESRGAN too, so any picture works.
models.license: MIT; DINOv3 under Meta's DINOv3 License

models.name: BiRefNet
models.about: Removes a picture's background: the subject on a transparent background, for sprites, cut-outs and 3D models.

models.name: Real-ESRGAN x4plus
models.about: Makes pictures two or four times larger with their detail restored rather than blurred.
